title: Heron at the reeds
summary: A grey heron standing still at the edge of the reeds, on water covered with green leaves.
content:
A grey heron standing still at the edge of the reeds, on water so covered with leaves that it looks like a lawn. It didn't move the whole time I was there.

Sony RX10 V · f/8 · 1/20 s · ISO 400
